title: Which AI tools support Claude linked billing?
notes: Append new platforms to `platforms`. Every entry needs at least one primary source (Anthropic page or the platform's own docs/blog/changelog). Never cite an aggregator or an AI agent. `added` = date this tracker first listed it; `lastVerified` = date a human or radar run re-opened the sources. `launchCohort: true` only for the 19 named in Anthropic's 17 Nov 2026 announcement. `logo` (optional): path to a locally saved logo under site/logos/, only once usage rights are confirmed; otherwise a monogram is drawn.

platforms.name: Asana
platforms.summary: Work management platform for teams running work across people and AI agents.
platforms.covers: Claude usage that powers Asana's agentic work management, including AI Studio and AI Teammates.
platforms.notCovered: Asana's own subscription is billed separately by Asana.

platforms.name: ClickHouse Cloud
platforms.summary: Fully managed analytical database for data engineers, developers and AI agents.
platforms.covers: All Claude model usage across ClickHouse Cloud products, such as ClickHouse Agents, at your Claude organization's rates and commitments.
platforms.notCovered: Organizations with HIPAA or PCI DSS compliance enabled can't link; their Claude models keep being served from Amazon Bedrock.
platforms.availability: Public preview; ClickHouse Cloud organizations without HIPAA or PCI DSS compliance enabled (ClickHouse Admin role needed)
platforms.fallback: Claude requests stop until the spend limit resets or is raised

sources.label: ClickHouse docs: Linked billing with Claude Platform

platforms.name: Cosmos by Harness
platforms.summary: Software factory that takes engineering work from ticket to production.
platforms.covers: Claude API usage in Cosmos by Harness.
platforms.notCovered: Any Harness subscription is billed separately.

platforms.name: Factory
platforms.summary: Claude-powered Droids for planning, coding, review, testing and incident response.
platforms.covers: Claude usage in Factory. An admin links the Claude organization once instead of sharing an API key.
platforms.notCovered: Factory's own subscription is billed separately.
platforms.availability: Not stated in source (Anthropic quote refers to enterprise customers)

platforms.name: Gumloop
platforms.summary: Lets anyone at a company build and use agents to automate their work.
platforms.covers: Claude model calls in Gumloop agents and flows, at 0 Gumloop model credits (same as bring-your-own-key).
platforms.notCovered: Tool calls and compute are charged as usual, and agent chats carry a 16% orchestration fee instead of 8%. Other providers need their own key.
platforms.availability: Enterprise (organization-wide, set by an org admin) or Pro (personal)
platforms.fallback: Claude calls fail; agents with model fallback switch to their fallback model

sources.label: Gumloop help: Use linked billing for Claude
Gumloop docs: Credits (BYOK and linked billing)

platforms.name: Higgsfield AI
platforms.summary: AI creative production platform for marketing teams, agencies and filmmakers.
platforms.covers: Claude usage in Supercomputer chats (web, mobile, Slack, Telegram) and the studio assistants, plus their sub-agents and context compaction. Playable Ads runs on Enterprise plans.
platforms.notCovered: Image, video, audio and 3D generations, paid agent tools and non-Claude models still use Higgsfield credits.
platforms.fallback: Switches to Higgsfield credits for the rest of the reply

sources.label: Higgsfield blog: launch partner for linked billing
Higgsfield docs: Link your Claude organization

platforms.name: Kilo Code
platforms.summary: AI coding agent for VS Code, JetBrains, the terminal and Kilo Desktop (listed by Anthropic as Kilo by Anaconda).
platforms.covers: Claude API usage in all Kilo features through the Kilo Gateway, including Kilo Desktop, Cloud Agents, the CLI and Code Reviews. Personal and organization links.
platforms.notCovered: Kilo charges no credits for linked requests. Claude Pro and Max subscriptions don't qualify.
platforms.fallback: Request fails (no fallback to Kilo credits)

sources.label: Kilo blog: Kilo now supports linked billing

platforms.name: Linear
platforms.summary: Product development system; its cloud coding agent turns issues into draft pull requests.
platforms.covers: Model usage for Claude Code coding sessions in Linear's cloud coding agent, including sessions started by Loops.
platforms.notCovered: Loop usage and sandbox runtime still use Linear AI credits.
platforms.availability: All Linear plans that include the cloud coding agent
platforms.fallback: Work stops (no fallback to Linear credits)

sources.label: Linear docs: Cloud coding agent (Link your Claude organization)

platforms.name: Major
platforms.summary: Governed platform to build, ship and run internal apps, workflows and AI agents.
platforms.covers: Claude usage from chats, agents and apps that use Major's AI proxy.
platforms.notCovered: Major still shows your usage, priced at Anthropic's list price.
platforms.fallback: Claude calls fail (no fallback to Major credentials)

sources.label: Major docs: Models (Link your Claude organization)

platforms.name: Mintlify
platforms.summary: Documentation and knowledge platform for customers, internal teams and AI agents.
platforms.covers: Claude API usage from the Mintlify assistant, agent, automations and Autopilot, per project.
platforms.fallback: AI features stop on linked projects

sources.label: Mintlify blog: Enterprise supports linked billing
Mintlify docs: Bring your own model

platforms.name: Niteshift
platforms.summary: Cloud agent platform running Claude Code and Codex in full-stack dev environments.
platforms.covers: Claude usage from Niteshift tasks, billed to the linked Claude organization under its existing terms.
platforms.notCovered: Codex runs use OpenAI credentials you provide; only Claude usage goes through the link.
platforms.availability: A Niteshift organization admin links it for the whole organization
platforms.fallback: Tasks that can't bill stop with Anthropic's billing error

sources.label: Niteshift docs: Model access and billing

platforms.name: Omni Analytics
platforms.summary: AI analytics platform built on a governed semantic layer.
platforms.covers: Claude usage in Omni, traceable back to Omni alongside Omni's own usage tracking.
platforms.notCovered: Any Omni subscription is billed separately.

platforms.name: OpenArt
platforms.summary: AI video agent platform for ads, series and brand films.
platforms.covers: Claude API usage in OpenArt's agentic layer.
platforms.notCovered: Any OpenArt subscription is billed separately.

platforms.name: Railway
platforms.summary: Cloud platform that builds, deploys, networks and scales your apps.
platforms.covers: Claude API usage in Railway Agent, Cloud Agents and the Slack and Discord bots.
platforms.notCovered: Only billing is linked; requests still run in Railway's organization.
platforms.availability: Railway workspace admin starts the link
platforms.fallback: Agents retry; members can switch to a Railway model

sources.label: Railway blog: Railway now supports linked billing

platforms.name: Ramp Router
platforms.summary: One endpoint that routes requests across leading AI models.
platforms.covers: Claude requests Router sends directly to Anthropic, across its Responses, Chat Completions and Messages endpoints, for every company API key.
platforms.notCovered: Claude via Amazon Bedrock, requests using Anthropic's code execution tool, and members' own Anthropic keys.

platforms.name: Runlayer
platforms.summary: Discover, secure and manage AI clients and MCPs across the enterprise.
platforms.covers: Claude usage in Runlayer, with no API key to share.
platforms.notCovered: Any Runlayer subscription is billed separately.

platforms.name: Tessera AI
platforms.summary: AI platform that maps your digital estate to de-risk enterprise transformation.
platforms.covers: Claude usage in Tessera, using the customer's own Claude organization.
platforms.notCovered: Any Tessera subscription is billed separately.

platforms.name: Tines 3B
platforms.summary: Environment for teams to build, deploy and operationalize secure AI software.
platforms.covers: Claude API usage in Tines 3B and Tines Stories, via an Anthropic connector set to the "Linked billing" connection type.
platforms.notCovered: API keys remain supported; Tines' own subscription is separate.

sources.label: Tines blog: Put Claude to work across your business
Tines 3B docs: Connect your AI provider

platforms.name: Warp
platforms.summary: Open platform for building and running cloud software factories.
platforms.covers: The Warp Agent on desktop, CLI, web and cloud, including subagents and factory runs billed to the team.
platforms.notCovered: Claude Code and other tools that connect directly to Anthropic; Bedrock, Vertex AI or custom endpoints.
platforms.fallback: Can charge the team's Warp balance

sources.label: Warp blog: Warp now supports linked billing
Warp docs: Managing Claude linked billing
